environment: Existing Convex development backend; local web preview; mobile source
flow: User taps Listen on an owned completed assistant reply
Server loads the saved answer; client cannot supply arbitrary text
Formatting and raw URLs removed, visible service names/locations/intake/valid phone retained
Long answers split into ordered sections, each at most 1200 UTF-8 bytes
Speech generated with an instruction to preserve the original English/Kiswahili text
Audio delivered inline to authenticated caller; no public storage URL
One active player; explicit Stop and local replay; next section generated only after current section completes
privacy: No automatic speech or microphone permission
AI voice and OpenAI shown alongside Listen controls
No answer text or audio written to AI cost ledger
Web audio cached in component memory and revoked on close/navigation/account change

Native audio cached in app cache; deletion requested on close/unmount/account change. Navigation or backgrounding stops playback; a retained screen can retain its cache, and abrupt termination may leave OS cache files
Late responses cannot start playback after the player closes
Player stops when backgrounded or unfocused; no queued generation starts in a background screen

costs.reservation: Conservative ~0.20 USD per section, reconciled from final SSE input/output token receipt; an application estimate, not a provider-enforced output cap
costs.rateLimit: 20 speech sections per 10 minutes per user, plus existing shared 10 AI calls/minute and 100/day
costs.failedOrInterrupted: Retain allowance when provider usage is uncertain
costs.sameSectionReplay: No extra paid call while audio remains cached; in-flight stop/replay shares its request
costs.newSelectionOrReload: Can require a new paid generation after previous player cache is disposed

verification.nativePlayback: passed on iPhone 17 Pro Max simulator: existing synthetic beneficiary signed in; English speech decoded and played, audio timer advanced (10s/14s in first test and 12s/17s after final UI update), Stop reset playback to zero, replay worked from cached audio
verification.nativeMicrophone: not exercised in this spoken-output change
verification.nativeAccount: Existing synthetic beneficiary development fixture; no new identity created
verification.finalBuilds: Web and mobile types, web build and Expo web export passed after final playback lifecycle changes

scopeLimits: Tap-to-listen replies, not continuous hands-free Realtime conversation
Kiswahili pronunciation/accent quality still needs human listening evaluation
Existing legal-source approval and directory readiness restrictions unchanged
